constraints.order: query order; ascending nonteacher candidates then STOP

contract:
One TRAIN-only external linear feasibility reference; never learner training.

All taught answers must outrank every other retained candidate by one and clear
the unchanged raw STOP threshold by one. Pure-query weights and persistent bias
are zero. Solver weights are archived, never installed in the neuronal model.
Only --selfcheck may run before the project source/fixture/protocol freeze.

encoder.prior: contrastive sentence training includes QA and code pairs; contamination unknown
encoder.sentence_pooling: attention-mask mean including special tokens; L2 normalization
encoder.span_pooling: mean overlapping complete non-special subtokens; no normalization
encoder.truncation: reject; caller must declare any chunking

fixture_provenance.projection: only four training documents in first-ingestion order and sixteen existing teaching requests/values; extracted before diagnostic model outputs

interpretation: A verified witness is finite TRAIN representation capacity only; not neuronal learning, native-update-cone reachability, action execution or generalization. Failure/infeasibility/timeout is inconclusive without an independent certificate.
